<?php
function startGeneratorSelector19() {
    global $receiver, $method, $pair, $target, $other;
    try {
        echo 'G|';
        $receiver = $other;
        $method = 'resume';
        $pair = null;
        $target = null;
        yield 'value' => '7';
        yield 'tail' => 'X';
    } finally {
        echo 'C|';
    }
}
$target = new Fiber(static function (int $value, string $label = 'D', ...$extra) {
    try {
        echo $value, '|', $label, '|', $extra['tail'], '|';
        Fiber::suspend('Y');
        return 17;
    } finally {
        echo 'F|';
    }
});
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$other = new Fiber(static function () { return 23; });
$receiver = $target;
$method = 'StArT';
$pair = [&$receiver, &$method];
$result = $pair(...startGeneratorSelector19());
echo $result, '|', (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', (int)$other->isStarted();
purpose: Dynamic INIT selection precedes generator user code; completed iteration precedes callback entry and last-receiver cleanup.

    private WeakReference $weak;

    public function __destruct() { echo 'D', (int)($this->weak->get() === null), '|'; }

class StartThrowIterator376 implements Iterator {
    private int $position = 0;
    private WeakReference $weak;
    private bool $named;
    public function __construct(WeakReference $weak, bool $named) { $this->weak = $weak; $this->named = $named; }
    public function rewind(): void { global $pair, $target; $pair = null; $target = null; echo 'W|'; }
    public function valid(): bool { return true; }
    public function current(): mixed {
        global $original;
        if ($this->position === 0) { return new StartTraversablePayload376($this->weak); }
        echo 'T|';
        throw $original;
    }
    public function key(): mixed { return $this->named ? 'payload' : 0; }
    public function next(): void { ++$this->position; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'I|'; }
}
foreach ([false, true] as $named) {
    $target = new Fiber(static function () { try { Fiber::suspend('Y'); } finally { echo 'F|'; } });
    $target->start();
    $weak = WeakReference::create($target);
    $pair = [$target, 'start'];
    $original = new Exception('iterator');
    try { $pair(...new StartThrowIterator376($weak, $named)); }
    catch (Throwable $error) { echo 'C', (int)($error === $original), '|', $error->getMessage(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null), '|'; }
    unset($error, $original);
}
echo 'END';
purpose: A real Iterator callback throws before repeated-start status; temporary iterator retires before positional/receiver/named pending-call owners.

$closed->next();
try { $target->start(...$closed); }
catch (Throwable $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
